verses.text: I cry with my voice unto Jehovah; With my voice unto Jehovah do I make supplication.

segments.text: I cry with my voice unto Jehovah;
With my voice unto Jehovah do I make supplication.

verses.text: I pour out my complaint before him; I show before him my trouble.

segments.text: I pour out my complaint before him;
I show before him my trouble.

verses.text: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, Thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walk Have they hidden a snare for me.

segments.text: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me,

verses.text: Look on my right hand, and see; For there is no man that knoweth me: Refuge hath failed me; No man careth for my soul.

verses.text: I cried unto thee, O Jehovah; I said, Thou art my refuge, My portion in the land of the living.

verses.text: Attend unto my cry; For I am brought very low: Deliver me from my persecutors; For they are stronger than I.

verses.text: Bring my soul out of prison, That I may give thanks unto thy name: The righteous shall compass me about; For thou wilt deal bountifully with me.
